preconditions.description: The dimensions n and m are integers between 1 and 50 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(grid) == n and all(len(row) == m for row in grid)
preconditions.description: The grid contains exactly n rows, each with exactly m characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '#.' for row in grid for c in row)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the grid is either '#' (painted) or '.' (empty).
The set of painted squares A is non-empty.
The initial set of painted squares A is connected.

postconditions.expression: result == -1 if len(painted_cells) <= 2 else (1 if is_articulation_point_exists(painted_cells, n, m) else 2)
postconditions.description: If the number of painted squares is 1 or 2, output -1 (impossible to disconnect). Otherwise, output 1 if removing a single square disconnects the set, else output 2.
The output is always one of -1, 1, or 2.
